summary:
Exhaustive Production Implementation Specification for Category Logistics, Couriers & Delivery in Algeria:
- Complete feature-by-feature specification covering: 58-Wilaya Cascading Matrix & Zonal Tariffs, High-Speed Barcode Scanning & Sac-Navette Bagging, Décret 05-468 Legal Transport Manifest (Lettre de Voiture), Double-Lock COD Vault & Courier Discharge, Stop-Desk OTP Handover, Reverse Logistics & Return Reason Codes, Algérie Poste CCP SFP 01 / BaridiMob Multi-Channel Remittance, and Hybrid Driver Payroll (Salaried vs Auto-Entrepreneur Commission).
- For every feature: Purpose, Business Logic with State Machines and worked numerical examples, Data Models (TypeScript + Quadruple Traceability), Code Architecture, UX flows (with French/Arabic/English microcopy and competitor-beating delight), all 9 Edge Case categories handled, and Acceptance Criteria.
- Strict Role-Based Separation of UI across 4 distinct operational personas (Gérant, Dispatcher, Agent de Tri Hub, Agent Stop-Desk) with dedicated TopBar switcher and role-locked sidebars.
- Cross-feature conflict checks, Self-Review fixing 10 weakest points, thin vertical slice build order, and Definition of Done. Zero code modification made in this turn.
